findings.text: the landing record's Measured table still names 0286810fff as the head arm and cites scoped-gate-1795049811700474600.log, so the delivered merge head 5c1f95f3 and its logs/merge-gate.log (5 passed EXIT=0) appear nowhere in the evidence a plan reader opens.

the fragment states the head run is an all_debug job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, but no artefact records either: logs/merge-gate.log's header names only revision, tree and command, and the run's logs directory holds no .scheduler sibling for the merge gate, so the clause is claimed rather than evidenced.

the suite arms the manifest records (this file and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py) import only reckon.interface_counts and name reckon/ledger.py solely as a census string, so after the merge added primary main's ledger and run_store code the done_when's arm over the test files that import what changed no longer covers the delivered delta.

_history_token recomposes the store-plus-archive change token that reckon/run_store.py:802 already owns for stored_run_payloads, reaching through the private _archive_path, so a change to the token's definition in its owner would leave this copy answering a different question than the store's readers.
